test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statement is correct on basis of the given passage?

options.text: Russia has visibly enhanced its influence in the Middle East and in Caucasus since the end of the Cold War.
Russia certainly wanted the United States presence in the Caucasus region.
East has become the victor of the East-West ideological rivalry post the cold war.
Western systems and Western influences, in general, started to dominate the whole world after the cold war.

solution:
The correct answer is **"Western systems and Western influences, in general, started to dominate the whole world after the cold war."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let us look at the first sentence of the passage:
 
 
• *"Another feature of the post-Cold War era is that since the West has become the victor of the East-West ideological rivalry, Western systems and Western influences, in general, started to dominate the whole world."*
